title: Dual-Mode Simulation-Backed Engine for Native System Sandboxes

claims.assertion: Sandboxed Harness plugins wrapping native OS executables must embed high-fidelity deterministic simulation fallbacks in their domain engines, ensuring contract and hygiene test suites execute with 100% reliability in CI environments where heavy binaries cannot be compiled.

distilled_learning: External tools and plugins often depend on platform-specific C++/Rust binaries, OS accessibility daemons, or display servers (UI Automation, AXUIElement, AT-SPI) that are absent or uncompiled in CI/CD runners and test containers. Implementing a dual-mode domain engine with an automatic simulation fallback allows the complete test suite (IoC resolution, protocol contracts, schema validation, and tool wrappers) to pass with 100% determinism while strictly isolating the real subprocess runner behind Rule 14 and Rule 53 transport safety nets.
